description: This Java source file defines the class JavaEventProducer, which handles multicast broadcasting of JavaEvent objects over UDP. It serializes events into JSON, manages socket communication, and supports listener registration for local event processing.

classes.name: JavaEventProducer
classes.description: Handles multicast broadcasting of JavaEvent objects, supporting JSON serialization, socket management, and local event listener registration.

methods.name: JavaEventProducer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes multicast socket, group address, and service ID.

methods.name: addEventAdapterListener
methods.description: Registers a local event adapter listener for pre-broadcast notification.

methods.description: Unregisters a local event adapter listener.

methods.name: broadcastEvent
methods.description: Serializes a JavaEvent as JSON, adds metadata, and broadcasts it via multicast UDP.
